QuestInfo.name: [3rd Day of Memories] Memories of Monkeys
QuestInfo.0: #p9010010# has something to discuss with you.
QuestInfo.2: Listening to #p9010010# made you realize that #p9000021# has some...interesting tastes. But more than that, #p9010010# really seems to look out for #p9000021#.

0.0: You were the one who got back all of #p9000021#'s Monkey Dolls, right? That made a lot of people very happy, especially the Cannoneers. However, #p9000021# told just a little while ago that he's having MORE monkey problems. Goodness... If I wasn't looking out for #p9000021# all the time, I don't know WHAT would happen to him. Do you mind helping us out?

yes.0: Wonderful. So this time, he lost #t3994388#s, not his regular Monkey Dolls. Did you know they made good-looking monkey dolls? Sometimes I wonder about #p9000021#'s taste... Anyway, I need you to eliminate monsters and bring me just 50 #t3994388#s. Oh, and remember that you won't find any on monsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you, so be careful!

no.0: Too busy for a little monkey business? Okay... I can wait.

1.0: You've got all 50 #t3994388#s? Let's see... Wait, this is a #t3994388#? It looks just like a normal one? What is #p9000021#'s deal?! He'd be so cute if he weren't so weird...

yes.0: Well, thanks for your help. I gave you some EXP, and I'd appreciate it if you could bring me more 'Good Looking' Monkey Dolls every 5 minutes or so. #p9000021# is anxious to rebuild his collection, so...do it for him, I guess.

default.0: Make sure you have 50 Good Looking Monkey Dolls. They're just not as good-looking in an incomplete set.
